title: DORA Article 19 / 25 Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Post-Mortem Report

root_cause_analysis.summary: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion triggered by unindexed query lock contention during peak load.

timeline.message: Asymmetric spike in HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors detected on Primary API Cluster.
Database connection pool exhaustion due to missing index on high-throughput query.
Applied emergency DB index hotfix and restarted connection pool instances.
All health probes returning HTTP 200 OK. RTO achieved: 10 minutes. RPO: 0 seconds.

remediation_action_items.action: Implement missing compound B-Tree index on transaction table.
Add connection pool exhaustion metric alert threshold at 80% utilization.
Incorporate connection pool failure scenario into bi-weekly DORA chaos tests.
